$comment: First hour of play: out of seeds, watering, season advice, selling after a harvest and from the inventory, seasonal starter kit (src/framework/selling.ts, src/services/farm.service.ts, src/commands/start.ts). Fragment merged into en.json at load time; same tree as fr/first_hour.json.

first_hour.no_seeds_hint: Every seed of your level is on sale every day in the shop's seed aisle.
first_hour.water_none_hint: None of your planted crops will need water before harvest.
first_hour.sell_menu_body:
Pick an item to sell to the village (all its stacks go), or sell all your harvests at once. Locked stacks are never sold.
`/auction sell`: offer a lot to other players (full price, 5% commission).
first_hour.sell_menu_empty: Nothing to sell yet. Harvest with `/harvest`, then come back here.
